name: Kurosaki Eru
source:
Eru is a grade below Hideaki, and acts like his younger sister. Whenever his parents are not home, Eru, who lives in the same neighborhood, comes over to perform domestic chores like cooking and cleaning. She has an obedient and generally quiet personality, but likes to joke with her friends. She is close friends with Minori, who is the same age as her.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orange_Pocket]Wikipedia[/url]]
